name: BathBodyWorks-Clone
description: BathBodyWorks is an American eCommerce website that sells mainly soaps, candles, perfume, etc. This is a collaborative project. We have created clone of BathBodyWorks website in 5 days. User able to signup and login successfully. Also user able to see, buy, add and make payment through website.

paragraphs: BathBodyWorks is a popular American Brand. BathBodyWorks is a retail store chain which came in Ecommerce buisness to sell their products. This Company sells products like lotions, soap, daily perfumes,candles,etc. This was a collaborative project buit by team of 4 members in 5 days.
features: Account creation, login, signup and logout functionality.
Product, Add to cart, Purchase and Checkout functionality.
